description: Generate flat vector editorial cover illustrations in a warm editorial style: near-black canvas, cream organic blob, serif display type, one terracotta accent, and thin line-art concept motifs (grids, node charts, dashed "unknown" paths, mountains, question marks). Output is code (HTML + inline SVG) rendered to a crisp 2400x960 PNG via headless Chrome. Use when you want a blog, article or X-article cover image, a "hero graphic", or "make a cover for <title>".
